Import each declaration by name, for example `import k.concurrency.Worker`.

| Declaration | Summary |
|---|---|

## Worker

> **Preview** (workers). Opt in with `preview = ["workers"]` in the `[package]` section of `k.toml`; it may change in any minor release.

```k,ignore
public struct Worker
```

Runs a service in a Web Worker, on the service: `@Worker`
(`docs/design/55-workers.md`). Its methods are calls from the page into
the worker: each is `async`, takes and returns `Codable` values, and
throws an error enum with a `workerFailure(`[`WorkerFailure`](#workerfailure)`)` case,
or [`WorkerOnlyError`](#workeronlyerror). The service keeps no state and injects nothing,
so the worker can be stopped and started again at any call: a cancelled
call terminates it, and a crash makes the call throw
`.workerFailure(.crashed)`. Its code ships in a chunk of its own,
started at the first call; `k test` runs it in-process.

## WorkerFailure

> **Preview** (workers). Opt in with `preview = ["workers"]` in the `[package]` section of `k.toml`; it may change in any minor release.

```k,ignore
public enum WorkerFailure implements Error, Codable
```

A failure outside a `@Worker` service's method, carried by the
`workerFailure` case every worker method's error enum has
(`docs/design/55-workers.md`, "Errors and crashes"). Only the runtime
produces it.

**Members**

- `case crashed`
  The worker stopped while it ran the call: the method panicked or
  threw something that isn't a Kobra error, or the browser ended it. The
  next call starts a new worker.
- `case unavailable`
  The browser couldn't start the worker: it has no `Worker`, or the
  worker's script failed to load (refused by a content security
  policy, or unreachable offline). The next call tries again.

## WorkerOnlyError

> **Preview** (workers). Opt in with `preview = ["workers"]` in the `[package]` section of `k.toml`; it may change in any minor release.

```k,ignore
public enum WorkerOnlyError implements Error, Codable
```

The error enum of a `@Worker` method with no errors of its own:
`func rank(query: String) async throws WorkerOnlyError -> List<Uuid>`.

**Members**

- `case workerFailure(WorkerFailure)`
  A failure outside the method ([`WorkerFailure`](#workerfailure)).
